name: Evalia: The Lust Kingdom
source: Evalia: The Lust Kingdom is an erotic sandbox RPG in which you get to become a ruler of a sex-obsessed city called Evalia. The game allows you to build relationships with anyone in your kingdom, including unique NPCs that are a part of your kingdom, as well as randomly generated NPCs that live in Evalia. Anyone can become your lover, waifu/husbando, sextoy, sex slave – the sky’s the limit!
translation: 《Evalia: The Lust Kingdom》是一款色情沙盒角色扮演遊戲，你將成為伊瓦利亞這座滿城迷戀性愛的城市的統治者。你可以和王國內的任何人發展關係，既有王國內設計各異的獨特角色，也有隨機生成、生活在伊瓦利亞的居民。誰都可以成為你的情人、老婆或老公、性玩具、性奴——一切皆有可能！
